slides.title:
The cloud didn't
shrink your network.
slides.body:
It moved a failure domain into
*somebody else's* routing table.

slides.title: And left you the ticket
slides.body:
That trade is often worth making.
It is rarely made *deliberately*.

slides.title: First workload moves
slides.body:
Someone builds a VPN,
because it is the fastest
thing that works.

slides.title: By the fourth
slides.body:
A direct connect. Two tunnels
nobody will decommission.
Routing policy in *three places*.

slides.title: That agrees in two
slides.body:
Nobody designed this.
It accumulated, one urgent
project at a time.

slides.title: Each decision was correct
slides.body:
Which is why nothing
ever got revisited.

slides.title: On-premises you owned every hop
slides.body:
You could instrument it,
capture it, *fix it*.

slides.title: Now the path crosses an edge
slides.body:
One you cannot see into.
"It isn't us — and we
*can't prove that*."

slides.title: Worth asking
steps: Can you see loss to the provider edge?

slides.title: The cost isn't the outage.
slides.body:
It's the hour spent establishing
*whose outage it is*.
